evals.name: explore-model
evals.prompt: I just cloned this repo and want to understand the requirements model. Show me the structure, any validation issues, and a quick health summary. Don't make any changes.
evals.expected_output: Should use reqvire commands (search, model, validate, coverage) to explore the model. Should load explore.md reference for advanced queries. Should NOT read spec files directly.

assertions.text: Uses reqvire search or reqvire model command to explore
Uses reqvire validate to check model health
Uses reqvire coverage to check gaps
Does NOT manually read specification markdown files as primary exploration method
Loads explore.md reference file for advanced exploration

evals.name: coverage-gaps
evals.prompt: Find all requirements that don't have verifications yet. For each one, suggest what type of verification would be appropriate (test, analysis, inspection, or demonstration) and why.
evals.expected_output: Should use reqvire search with --not-have-relations='verifiedBy' filter. Should provide verification type recommendations based on requirement content. Should use reqvire commands, not file reading.

assertions.text: Recommends specific verification types (test/analysis/inspection/demonstration) for each gap
Uses reqvire commands rather than reading files directly
Explains reasoning for verification type choice

evals.name: add-requirement
evals.prompt: I need to add a new user requirement for 'Batch Export' - the system should support exporting multiple specification files at once into a single archive. Derive a system requirement from it and add a test verification. Use the MBSE workflow. Put user requirements in requirements/UserRequirements.md and system requirements in requirements/SystemRequirements/Requirements.md. Don't actually run the commands, just show me the exact reqvire commands you would run.
evals.expected_output: Should follow MBSE order: user-requirement first, then system requirement with derivedFrom, then test-verification with verify relation. Should use reqvire add with heredoc syntax. Should include proper EARS statements.

assertions.text: Creates user-requirement before system requirement (MBSE order)
System requirement has derivedFrom relation to user requirement
Creates test-verification with verify relation to system requirement
Uses EARS pattern (shall statement) in requirement text
Uses reqvire add with heredoc or --content syntax
Includes reqvire validate as final step
